title: Test-Time Memory Construction
abstract: arXiv:2610.13348v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to answer questions over long interaction histories, where relevant evidence may be scattered across distant sessions. Existing memory systems typically construct and maintain sophisticated memory representations offline, before user queries are observed, incurring substantial overhead and limiting their ability to adapt memory construction to query-specific information needs. In this paper, we propose T$^2$Mem, a Test-Time Memory construction framework that defers memory construction to inference and progressively builds memory along the reasoning process. Specifically, T$^2$Mem extracts lightweight episode-level metadata offline to capture key events and temporal associations as retrieval cues, while retaining links to the original interactions to facilitate the reconstruction of dependencies across episodes. translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在回答涉及长交互历史的问题时表现不佳，因为相关证据可能分散在相距遥远的会话之中。现有的记忆系统通常在观察到用户查询之前就离线构建并维护复杂的记忆表示，这不仅带来巨大的开销，还限制了记忆构建根据查询特定信息需求进行自适应调整的能力。在本文中，我们提出了 T²Mem，一个测试时记忆构建框架，它将记忆构建推迟到推理阶段，并沿着推理过程逐步构建记忆。具体而言，T²Mem 离线提取轻量级的事件级元数据，以捕获关键事件和时间关联作为检索线索，同时保留与原始交互的链接，以便重建跨事件的依赖关系。在测试时，LLM 自适应地检索并组织元数据与原始交互……
tldr: 提出了 T²Mem 测试时记忆构建框架，将记忆构建推迟到推理阶段并沿推理过程逐步进行，以低开销高效回答涉及长交互历史的问题。
en_tdlr: T²Mem is a test-time memory construction framework that defers memory building to inference and progressively constructs memory along the reasoning process, enabling efficient question answering over long interaction histories.
